schema_reference: Modeled on Rhine/Danube River Information Services (RIS) data domains, per Akash Sir's spec

fairway_information.note: Requires real fairway data for NW-53: channel depth, width, navigability restrictions. Modeled on RIS 'fairway information' domain (waterway-only data).
fairway_information.data_source_needed: Sea routes / river data (per Akash Sir's spec), NISAR satellite bathymetry

traffic_information.note: Requires real-time vessel/traffic tracking data for NW-53 jetties and connecting ports. Modeled on RIS 'traffic information' (tactical + strategic vessel positions, akin to Inland AIS).
traffic_information.data_source_needed: Map My India real-time traffic/location API and other GIS markers

water_level_and_tide_data.note: Requires real tide, salinity, and water-level data for the MMR corridor. Modeled on RIS gauge-station ('Pegelstellen') data.
water_level_and_tide_data.data_source_needed: Tide data, salinity and water level data, weather data

locks_and_berths_index.note: Requires a reference index of locks, berths, and waterway objects along NW-53, analogous to the RIS Index used on the Rhine/Danube (unique codes + restricting conditions per object).
locks_and_berths_index.data_source_needed: Land routes data, port/jetty infrastructure records

notices_to_skippers.note: Requires a live safety/navigability alert feed for NW-53 (hazards, closures, seasonal restrictions). Modeled on RIS 'Notices to Skippers'.
notices_to_skippers.data_source_needed: Not yet identified -- no Indian inland-waterway equivalent confirmed

cargo_fleet_management.note: Requires vessel/fleet and cargo-volume data moving through NW-53 jetties. Modeled on RIS 'cargo and fleet management' information.
cargo_fleet_management.data_source_needed: Land traffic data, logistics cost/volume data

traffic_growth_projection.note: Requires a real annual growth-rate assumption and a base-year cargo/traffic figure before any 50-100 year projection can be produced.
traffic_growth_projection.methodology: future_value = base_year_cargo_tonnes * (1 + growth_rate_annual_pct/100) ** years, for years in projection_horizon_years

known_gaps: This is a schema/structure design only -- no live data source is connected for any category.
